reviews.author: Hali Baker
reviews.text: We had a contract. We paid up front for the season. He didn’t show up for the bi-weekly services even when I was texting asking him to come. Always had excuses for not coming. We are still owed $200 from the upfront payment to them. First year of the contract was great. Second year, sadly this happened.

reviews.author: Manu Mathew
reviews.text: Mark and his team are excellent at mowing my lawn. They are experts and know how to remove weeds. Mark and his team communicates with you promptly and make sure you are satisfied. They have reasonable price and caters to all your lawn needs! I highly recommend him for your lawn services!

reviews.author: Mike
reviews.text: American Landscaping Services crushed it! Mark and his team were solid from start to finish, professional, responsive, and knew exactly what they were doing. They took the time to get every detail right, and the results speak for themselves. The yard looks amazing, and the whole process was smooth. Highly recommend Mark if you want top-quality service from someone who actually cares. I’ll be using him for all my other properties moving forward.

reviews.author: Ahmed Amin
reviews.text: Look no further if you are looking for a good landscaper! I couldn’t be happier with the work Mark and his crew did on my property! From start to finish, they were professional, reliable, and paid close attention to detail. They transformed my yard with expert landscaping and beautiful plant selections. The crew was courteous and worked efficiently, leaving everything clean and looking amazing. If you’re looking for top-notch landscaping services, I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Honey Dew
reviews.text: I am extremely disappointed in American landscape and services within the last 2 weeks. I have called the company practically every day, I have left voice messages and no response. I finally received a text from Mark stating he would call me in 10 minutes on June 27th. He never called back. Since then I have been calling few times a day leaving messages for him to contact me. I believe he is ignoring my calls because he refuses to do the work, the follow through with Mark is extremely unprofessional!

reviews.author: Zulaica Montas
reviews.text: I reach out to Mark to help us trim our trees, add new mulch, clean our yard and take care of the weeds. Mark and his team did an excellent job. Mark kept in contact with us through the job and gave us a reasonable price for our small yard. He made sure we were happy with his work before leaving and went above and beyond with the result. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Tenesha
reviews.text: Didn't complete job. Over charged me. And does not return calls or text. Never again. There was more than a water bottle left there. It trash and leaves still under and behind the tree in the front area. As well, you took a broken garbage can and filled it with the grass and weeds instead of bagging it up. And left it on the side of the house like that.

reviews.author: Edwin Rondon
reviews.text: Mark is very professional, goes above and beyond to keep the customer happy, he has been on top of my home’s landscaping doing an excellent job at an affordable price and so far I have no complaints.

reviews.author: Dana B (Danaxx)
reviews.text: Mark has been doing my landscaping for years. He is punctual & professional. Great services at a great price.

reviews.author: Sulyvan Moreno
reviews.text: Excelente service I would use it again and again. Perfect combination of good price and quality of service.

reviews.author: BENJAMINJGRIMM
reviews.text: Doesn't answer the phone, doesn't return calls. Didn't complete job and asked for full payment. Don't bother.
